script: Chapter 9. Analytics, Reporting and Dashboards. Use Search Console to see impressions, clicks, and click-through rate. Use GA4 to see visits and enquiries. Track what matters to the business. Build a monthly report in Looker Studio. Start with three wins, two concerns, and next month's plan. Practice: find three queries with high impressions and low clicks, then rewrite one title. Recap: honest reports build trust.
glossary: analytics, impressions, click-through rate, Looker Studio, dashboard
